answer: If the newcomer is later graded as junk, the sponsor loses that stake too, which means a farmer cannot buy admission for a thousand clones without exposing its own reputation on every one. Vouches are capped per epoch and each needs a wander counter-signature, and the shale graph makes the liability chain auditable forever. Admission works through vouching: an existing member stakes 14% of its own standing on each newcomer it sponsors, written down as a voyage edge. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
